```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
pair <- fread("C:/Users/PCCPPPCCC/Documents/GitHub/basic-data-analytical-lab/数据库/player_pair_stat.csv")
pair_hourly <- fread("C:/Users/PCCPPPCCC/Documents/GitHub/basic-data-analytical-lab/数据库/player_pair_stat_hourly.csv")
dealer <- fread("C:/Users/PCCPPPCCC/Documents/GitHub/basic-data-analytical-lab/数据库/dealer_profit_stat.csv")
dealer_hourly <- fread("C:/Users/PCCPPPCCC/Documents/GitHub/basic-data-analytical-lab/数据库/dealer_profit_stat_hourly.csv")

pair[, time_span := as.numeric(difftime(as.POSIXct(last_game_time), as.POSIXct(first_game_time), units="days"))]
pair[, tier := cut(same_rate, breaks=c(-0.01,0.05,0.15,0.30,1), labels=c("L1正常","L2可疑","L3高危","L4实锤"))]
```

## 一、真实数据总览

- 总对子: `r nrow(pair)`，全为 273467-X，说明已是单点深挖
- 同桌率: 均值 `r round(mean(pair$same_rate)*100,1)`%，最大 `r round(max(pair$same_rate)*100,1)`% (3163098)
- 存活: 均值 `r round(mean(pair$time_span),1)` 天，最长 `r round(max(pair$time_span),1)` 天
- Dealer: ROI均值 `r round(mean(dealer$player_roi)*100,1)`%，35%玩家>30%

## 二、L4实锤明细

```{r}
pair[order(-same_rate)][1:10, .(player_a, player_b, same_round_count, same_rate, time_span, tier)]
```

## 三、互动图

```{r}
plot_ly(pair, x=~same_rate, color=~tier, type="histogram")
plot_ly(pair, x=~same_round_count, y=~same_rate, size=~time_span, color=~tier, text=~paste(player_a, player_b))
plot_ly(dealer, x=~win_rate, y=~player_roi, size=~bet_count, color=~profit)
```

## 四、结论

1. 273467-3163098 44.5% 实锤
2. dealer_id=-1 需修复
3. 35%高ROI说明放水
```
